The test patches `main.CONFIG` with a path to `config.ini` in the assets directory. Looking at `get_host_config` for reference on how to read the config, I can see the pattern for reading from `CONFIG`.

The config.ini likely has an `[organization]` section with `id` and `name` fields.

```python
def get_organization() ->Optional[Organization]:
    config = configparser.ConfigParser()
    config.read(CONFIG)

    if not config.has_section("organization"):
        return None

    org_section = dict(config.items("organization"))

    org_id = org_section.get("id", None)
    org_name = org_section.get("name", None)

    if not org_id:
        return None

    return Organization(id=org_id, name=org_name)
```
